concept.title: Configuring SSL/TLS and routes
concept.shortdesc: Configuring SSL/TLS and routes for Red Hat Quay lets you control how TLS termination and route management work together. The tls component provides support for OpenShift Container Platform edge termination routes and enables independent control of route management and TLS certificate handling.

conbody.p: EXTERNAL_TLS_TERMINATION: true is the default, opinionated setting, which assumes the cluster manages TLS termination.

ul.li: When tls is managed, the cluster’s default wildcard certificate is used.
When tls is unmanaged, you must supply your own SSL/TLS certificate and key pair.
